<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">（<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="60002021" href="/cmn-hant/%E5%A4%9A%E5%AA%92%E9%AB%94%E5%9C%96%E6%9B%B8%E9%A4%A8/%E8%81%96%E7%B6%93/%E7%B2%BE%E8%AE%80%E6%9C%AC%E8%81%96%E7%B6%93/%E8%81%96%E7%B6%93%E5%8D%B7%E7%9B%AE/%E5%BD%BC%E5%BE%97%E5%89%8D%E6%9B%B8/2/#v60002021" target="_blank"><ruby><rb>彼得前書</rb><rt>Bǐdé Qiánshū</rt></ruby>2:21</a>）</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1．</span><ruby><rb>耶和華</rb><rt>Yēhéhuá</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>就是</rb><rt>jiùshì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>愛</rb><rt>ài</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz"><ruby><rb>樂意</rb><rt>Lèyì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>施</rb><rt>shī</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>恩</rb><rt>ēn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>行善</rb><rt>xíngshàn</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp"><ruby><rb>他</rb><rt>Tā</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>為</rb><rt>wèi</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>全</rb><rt>quán</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>人類</rb><rt>rénlèi</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>獻</rb><rt>xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>出</rb><rt>chū</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>寶貴</rb><rt>bǎoguì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>兒子</rb><rt>érzi</rt></ruby>。</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sp"><ruby><rb>耶穌</rb><rt>Yēsū</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>擔當</rb><rt>dāndāng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>重任</rb><rt>zhòngrèn</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sz"><ruby><rb>甘願</rb><rt>Gānyuàn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>降世</rb><rt>jiàngshì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>為</rb><rt>wéi</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>人</rb><rt>rén</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sp"><ruby><rb>他</rb><rt>Tā</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>完美</rb><rt>wánměi</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>榜樣</rb><rt>bǎngyàng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>為</rb><rt>wèi</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>上帝</rb><rt>Shàngdì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>增光</rb><rt>zēngguāng</rt></ruby>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2．</span><ruby><rb>耶穌</rb><rt>Yēsū</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>一生</rb><rt>yìshēng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>遵行</rb><rt>zūnxíng</rt></ruby></p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz"><ruby><rb>耶和華</rb><rt>Yēhéhuá</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>的</rb><rt>de</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>話語</rb><rt>huàyǔ</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sp"><ruby><rb>他</rb><rt>Tā</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>充滿</rb><rt>chōngmǎn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>智慧</rb><rt>zhìhuì</rt></ruby>、<ruby><rb>知識</rb><rt>zhīshi</rt></ruby>，<ruby><rb>明辨</rb><rt>míngbiàn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>事理</rb><rt>shìlǐ</rt></ruby>。</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sp"><ruby><rb>耶穌</rb><rt>Yēsū</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>甘心</rb><rt>gānxīn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>樂意</rb><rt>lèyì</rt></ruby></p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sz"><ruby><rb>聽從</rb><rt>Tīngcóng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>上帝</rb><rt>Shàngdì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>命令</rb><rt>mìnglìng</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp"><ruby><rb>他</rb><rt>Tā</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>多麼</rb><rt>duōme</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>開心</rb><rt>kāixīn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>讓</rb><rt>ràng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>天父</rb><rt>Tiānfù</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>歡喜</rb><rt>huānxǐ</rt></ruby>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">3．</span><ruby><rb>我們</rb><rt>Wǒmen</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>仔細</rb><rt>zǐxì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>留意</rb><rt>liúyì</rt></ruby></p>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sz"><ruby><rb>耶穌</rb><rt>Yēsū</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>一切</rb><rt>yíqiè</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>言行</rb><rt>yánxíng</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sp"><ruby><rb>要</rb><rt>Yào</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>向</rb><rt>xiàng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>他</rb><rt>tā</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>學習</rb><rt>xuéxí</rt></ruby>，<ruby><rb>天天</rb><rt>tiāntiān</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>榮耀</rb><rt>róngyào</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>上帝</rb><rt>Shàngdì</rt></ruby>。</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp"><ruby><rb>一生</rb><rt>Yìshēng</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>緊緊</rb><rt>jǐnjǐn</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>跟從</rb><rt>gēncóng</rt></ruby></p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sz"><ruby><rb>耶穌</rb><rt>Yēsū</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>基督</rb><rt>Jīdū</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>腳蹤</rb><rt>jiǎozōng</rt></ruby>，</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sp"><ruby><rb>效法</rb><rt>Xiàofǎ</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>他</rb><rt>tā</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>榜樣</rb><rt>bǎngyàng</rt></ruby>，<ruby><rb>上帝</rb><rt>Shàngdì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>必</rb><rt>bì</rt></ruby><ruby><rb>讚賞</rb><rt>zànshǎng</rt></ruby>。</p>
</li>
</ol>
